===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Atheros]] AR7161 @680MHz ([[MIPS 24K]]) *Storage: 64KB (SPI) Serial, 128MB (NAND) Flash, :TF card (max.64GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 256MB (DDR) SDRAM *Network: 9x Gigabit Ethernet ports *USB: 1x USB 2.0 port *PCI: 3x MiniPCI slots *Power: 8-28V via barrel or passive PoE
